title: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Uzaa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Yoma 46b, Rabbi Yochanan says that Rabbi Yehoshua ben Uzaa asked a question; Rabbi Yochanan then says that Rabbi Yehoshua ben Uzaa subsequently resolved it. The Bach and Dikdukei Soferim read Rabbi Yehoshua Uzaa, without ben. On that reading, Hyman takes him to be the Rabbi Yehoshua of Uza mentioned in the baraita in [Nedarim 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.38b.7); he would thus be a Tanna of a baraita.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied Yoma locator is 46b. At [Yoma 47b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.47b.2-3) Rabbi Yochanan first names Rabbi Yehoshua ben Uzaa and then says Yehoshua [ben] Uzaa answered his own question. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1774&lang=en) gives 47b and records the form without ben.
Nedarim gives Yehoshua of Uza without the title Rabbi. Hyman’s proposed identification depends on the name readings he reports from the Bach and Dikdukei Soferim.
